verdict.rationale: Google's docs say the official Google GenAI SDK is available for Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go and Java. A first-party GitHub repo (googleapis/python-genai) backs this up and ships Gemini API Skills so AI coding assistants generate correct SDK code. The API also works with the official OpenAI Python and TypeScript libraries by changing three lines of code. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the SDKs' quality and coverage.
